item.title: The body
item.description: Parts of the body and saying what hurts.

children.definition: the top part of your body, with your eyes, nose and mouth
children.example: I have a cold and my head is hot.

children.definition: the part of your face that you see with
the part of your head that you hear with
children.example: Put your hands over your ears. It's very loud!

children.definition: the part of your face that you smell with
children.example: My nose is red because I have a cold.

children.definition: the part of your face that you eat and speak with
one of the hard white things in your mouth that you bite with (plural: teeth)
children.example: I brush my teeth every morning and every evening.

children.definition: the part at the end of your arm, with four fingers and a thumb
the long part of your body between your shoulder and your hand
one of the two long parts of your body that you walk on
children.example: My legs are tired after the long walk.

children.definition: the part at the end of your leg that you stand on (plural: feet)
children.example: My left foot hurts in these new shoes.

children.definition: the part of your body behind you, from your neck to your bottom
children.example: I carry my school bag on my back.

children.definition: to feel pain in a part of your body
children.example: My stomach hurts. I can't eat.
